items.meaning: 大家一起完成的事；把功劳归于团队
items.quote: Well, it's a group effort.

items.chunk: knock it out of the park
items.meaning: 做得特别出色；口语赞扬
items.quote: I mean, the folks at HHM are just knockin' it out of the park.

items.meaning: 事情是这样的／关键在于……；引出重点
items.quote: Listen, here's the thing.

items.chunk: One thing has nothing to do with the other.
items.meaning: 这两件事没有关系；切断关联
items.quote: One thing has absolutely nothing to do with the other.

items.chunk: take myself out of the running
items.meaning: 退出候选／竞争；此处婉拒工作机会
items.quote: It's an honor to be considered, but at this time... At this time, um, I'm gonna have to take myself out of the running.

items.meaning: 以后你会感谢我的；劝对方接受建议
items.quote: You'll thank me later.

items.meaning: 在你自己的时间；此处指别占用工作时间
items.quote: Good. Then you be proud of it on your own time, but not with me.

items.meaning: 保护你／留意你的身后；此处指有人照应
items.quote: do not go to that meet without someone watching your back.

items.meaning: 轻松获利的好差事／财路；口语比喻

items.chunk: Your services are no longer needed.
items.meaning: 不再需要你的服务；正式、冷淡的解聘说法

items.meaning: 看法不同；委婉说明分歧
items.quote: Yeah, saw things differently. So... You know how it is.

items.meaning: 请便／随意；允许对方做某事
items.quote: Oh, be my guest. Get in.

items.meaning: 刚下生产线／新出厂；此处指新车
items.quote: Brand-new, off the line.

items.meaning: 按你的方式做／做你要做的事；口语
items.quote: Do your thing. Make sure it's right.

items.meaning: 你可以随意做某事；此处礼貌允许对方清点
items.quote: And, as always, you're welcome to count 'em.

items.meaning: 放弃／退出某事；此处指放弃工作机会
items.quote: Clearly explain to me why you walked out on the best job opportunity of your life.

items.meaning: 不用太讲究／普通的就行

items.meaning: 就这么简单；结束解释

items.meaning: 把费用记到房账上

items.meaning: 你来选／交给你决定；借用牌局说法

items.meaning: 你怎么突然说这个？；追问意外的话题

items.chunk: bend over backwards to do sth.
items.meaning: 竭尽全力去做某事；常指过度迁就

items.meaning: 出于完全不对的动机
items.quote: I got into the law for all the wrong reasons.

items.meaning: 相信自己的直觉
items.quote: I'm trusting my instincts.

items.meaning: 用在别处更有价值；此处指才华
items.quote: I think that my talents are better spent elsewhere.

items.meaning: 也有过不错的时候；对整体评价有所保留
items.quote: I'm not saying it didn't have its moments, but the stuff I liked about it, selling people, convincing people, I don't have to be a lawyer to do that.

items.meaning: 它没有发展后劲／支撑不了多久；此处指股票
items.quote: That stock is useless. It's got no legs.

items.meaning: 源源而来／到账；此处指钱进账
items.quote: Float around and wait for your Sandpiper money to roll in?

items.meaning: 与某事毫无关系／不影响某事；偏正式

items.meaning: 放弃／离开某个机会
items.quote: It's a great opportunity, and you're walking away from it.

items.chunk: Shouldn't you at least try… before…?
items.meaning: 至少先试一试再……，不行吗？；委婉劝说

items.meaning: 把某物白白丢掉；此处指多年努力
items.quote: All that effort, you're just gonna toss it away? That's the sunk cost fallacy.

items.meaning: 继续在已亏损的事上投入；越陷越深

items.meaning: 扭转运气／局面
items.quote: They throw good money after bad thinking they can turn their luck around.

items.meaning: 这样做让我得到了什么？；反问付出是否值得
items.quote: I've been doing the right thing for all these years now, and where has it gotten me?

items.meaning: 何必找那个麻烦？；反问

items.meaning: 跟着我做；让对方照自己的示范行动
items.quote: Follow my lead.

items.meaning: 解决一个打赌的争议；此处用来搭话
items.quote: Hey, buddy, could you settle a bet for us?

items.chunk: I don't want to make it sound like…
items.meaning: 我不想把这事说得像……；预先缓和说法
items.quote: I don't want to make it sound like I was eavesdropping, but I kind of was.

items.meaning: 很懂行／对自己的领域很熟
items.quote: This guy sounds like he knows his stuff.

items.chunk: put all your eggs in one basket
items.meaning: 把所有希望／资源押在一处
items.quote: You know that saying, "Don't put all your eggs in one basket," right? Same principle.

items.chunk: in the neighborhood of + 数字
items.meaning: 大约（某个数额）
items.quote: and he left us somewhere in the neighborhood of $1.4 million.

items.meaning: 幸运眷顾敢于冒险的人；劝说套语
items.quote: Fortune favors the bold, man.

items.meaning: 久经考验的稳妥选择
items.quote: Shoot for the tried and true.

items.meaning: 这正是某人发挥作用的时候；推介自己

items.meaning: 有经验证的过往业绩／可靠履历
items.quote: Proven track record as a wealth manager.

items.meaning: 承担经过权衡的风险
items.quote: I take calculated but aggressive risks

items.meaning: 没有必须承担的后续义务；推销时减轻压力

items.meaning: 别怕我／尽管过来；戏谑地打消顾虑

items.meaning: 确切地说；修正前述说法

items.meaning: 用得上一些……／需要一些……；委婉请求

items.meaning: 你方便的时候；放在请求后缓和语气
items.quote: so we could use a wine list, if you get a chance...

items.meaning: 愿意参加／接受某事；随意口语

items.chunk: the right time to jump in
items.meaning: 正是入场的好时机；此处指投资
items.quote: And you're picking the right time to jump in.

items.meaning: 由某人赠送／请客；服务场景

items.meaning: 我们准备结账了；餐厅用语
items.quote: I think we're ready for the check.

items.quote: But, so, to be clear, you take the money directly from our account and invest it.

items.meaning: 诸如此类等等；随意、含糊的补充
items.quote: And then all the dividends and all the profits and the what-have-you comes back into our account.

items.meaning: 不再打扰你／先告辞；口语
items.quote: All right, well, we should get out of your hair.

items.meaning: 合同或单据上的细则／小字条款
items.quote: - I didn't read the fine print. - Wait.

items.meaning: 我能搞定／我来处理；此处指自己想办法
items.quote: I got this.

items.meaning: 这样我可以接受／我没意见；此处在争执后说
items.quote: Good. I'm fine with this.

items.meaning: 这个值得留住／这个人值得珍惜；此处带玩笑意味
items.quote: That's a keeper.

items.meaning: 要是我们能……该多好；设想愿望的句式
items.quote: Hey, wouldn't it be great if we could do that every night? Yes, it would. But we can't. I know, yeah. But I'm just saying, if we could, it would be great. But I know we can't.

items.meaning: 我只是说说／我的意思是……；缓和立场
items.quote: But I'm just saying, if we could, it would be great.

items.meaning: 分派任务；dole out 常有逐一分发之感
items.quote: Howard is doling out assignments,

items.quote: Howard is doling out assignments, and the last one through the door could get stuck in doc review.

items.meaning: 众所周知的事
items.quote: Was it common knowledge that you have baseball cards?

items.meaning: 没有特定的人；此处询问有无明确嫌疑人

items.meaning: 不少／相当多；口语数量表达
items.quote: Cash, a fair bit, uh...

items.meaning: 暴露在外界环境中；此处指卡片离开保护套

items.meaning: 把一个地方翻得乱七八糟；此处指搜翻房间
items.quote: Well, they really tossed this place.

items.meaning: 只是想听听你的看法；试探性提问
items.quote: I don't know. Just wondering your thoughts.

items.meaning: 最珍贵的部分；此处指收藏中最好的卡片
items.quote: But these were the crown jewels over here.

items.meaning: 弄明白某事／解释某事
items.quote: Just trying to make sense of it. What's to make sense of?

items.meaning: 发疯似地行动／失控；此处指破坏

items.meaning: 服了兴奋剂而亢奋；粗俗口语，speed 指毒品
items.quote: Or hopped up on speed or whatever and went nuts with the vandalism?

items.chunk: get a great deal on sth.
items.meaning: 买到很划算的东西／拿到好条件
items.quote: Got a great deal on it.

items.meaning: 高价值商品／物品；此处指贵重卡片

items.meaning: 那些通常会被怀疑／想到的人或事；可带玩笑意味

items.chunk: There's something wrong with this picture.

items.meaning: 整理／准备出某物；此处指样品

items.meaning: 如果你需要什么……；主动提供帮助

items.meaning: 我马上着手办；回应工作请求
items.quote: Absolutely. I'll get right on that.
